coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

flag_sources.twin2: byte at 8(rdi) after loading the pointer at [rdi] into rbx

behavior.twin1_entry: flag 2 returns; odd flag goes to the swap; even flag checks the global cell, nonzero goes to the call arm, zero goes to the swap
behavior.twin2_entry: nonzero flag byte goes to the swap; zero flag byte checks the global cell, nonzero goes to the call arm, zero goes to the swap
behavior.call_arm: callee returns 1 exactly when the thread-local cell is zero; 1 skips the byte-4 set, 0 sets byte 4 of the flag object to 1, then both rejoin the swap
behavior.swap: atomically exchange 0 into the flag target; old value 2 takes the syscall tail jump, any other old value returns
behavior.differences: flag source, early flag-2 return only in twin 1, swap target register, and call-arm register save; global slot, call slot, syscall slot and immediates are shared

claim: two near-identical flag state machines differing only in flag source, early flag-2 return, swap target and call-arm register save
